localization.expanse12_raptor.pdc.name: Raptor PDC
localization.expanse12_raptor.rail.name: Scirocco light railgun
localization.expanse12_raptor_light_magazine.name: Martian light torpedoes
localization.expanse12_raptor_light_magazine.descript: 18 torpedoes; 3 every 10 seconds, cycling measured launcher positions. Reloads 120 seconds after empty. Targets detected enemies in the same gravity well. Reactor overdrive accelerates magazine progress.
localization.expanse12_raptor_reactor.name: Reactor overdrive
localization.expanse12_raptor_reactor.description: For 20 seconds: +25% speed and 25% faster weapon/magazine progress. Costs 75 antimatter; 120 seconds of recovery after the boost.
localization.expanse12_raptor_launch_corvette.name: Request MCRN reinforcement
localization.expanse12_raptor_launch_corvette.descrip: One MCRN Corvette arrives after 2 seconds. Costs 300 credits and 55 metal, requires 55 free supply; 120-second cooldown. Arrival placement is controlled by the engine.
localization.expanse12_raptor_marines.name: Marine boarding party
localization.expanse12_raptor_marines.description: One 20% capture attempt after 3 seconds against a detected capital, command ship or titan. Requires free supply; 600-second cooldown. Hero ships are excluded. Timed pod visual; captured titans may exceed the construction cap.
localization.expanse12_raptor_reactor_breach.name: Capital reactor breach
localization.expanse12_raptor_reactor_breach.descript: Destruction damages nearby friendly and enemy ships: 1,500 damage within 2,500 range.
